📺 Elle (2026–Present)

Elle follows a teenage Elle Woods as she navigates high school life in 1995, years before becoming the confident and ambitious young woman audiences fell in love with in Legally Blonde. When her family moves from glamorous Bel-Air to Seattle, Elle must adjust to a new school, unfamiliar friendships, complicated romances, and the challenges of fitting in. Despite unexpected setbacks and teenage drama, Elle’s kindness, determination, and unique personality help her discover her own strengths. Along the way, her close relationship with her mother becomes an important source of encouragement. Starring Lexi Minetree, the series delivers a heartwarming coming-of-age story about friendship, love, confidence, and staying true to yourself.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Romance • Coming-of-Age

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 43–56 minutes per episode • 8 episodes in Season 1

🎥 Creator: Laura Kittrell

📅 Release Date: July 1, 2026

🎬 Executive Producer: Reese Witherspoon

📺 Where to Watch: Prime Video in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Elle (also marketed as Elle: From the World of Legally Blonde) is an American comedy television series developed by Laura Kittrell, serving as a prequel to the Legally Blonde franchise. The series takes place six years before the events of the first film and it explores the high school years of teenage Elle Woods (originally portrayed by Reese Witherspoon), portrayed by newcomer Lexi Minetree. The series is helmed by showrunner Kittrell and is executive producing alongside Witherspoon and producer Marc Platt. Production began in April 2025. It premiered on July 1, 2026. In January 2026, the series was renewed for a second season.
